parameters.query:
WITH input AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS body),
payloads AS (
  SELECT entry.payload,entry.ordinal
  FROM input CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(body->'delivery_payloads')='array'
         THEN body->'delivery_payloads' ELSE jsonb_build_array(body) END
  ) WITH ORDINALITY AS entry(payload,ordinal)
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object('delivery_payloads',coalesce(jsonb_agg(
         payload || jsonb_build_object(
           'source',coalesce(nullif(payload->>'source',''),a.source,''),
           'metadata',coalesce(nullif(payload->'metadata','null'::jsonb),a.metadata,'{}'::jsonb),
           'matched_watch_names',coalesce(payload->'matched_watch_names',names.items,'[]'::jsonb)
         ) ORDER BY ordinal),'[]'::jsonb)) AS sender_input,
       coalesce((SELECT settings->'alert_appearance' FROM workspace_config WHERE singleton=true),
                '{}'::jsonb) AS alert_appearance
FROM payloads
LEFT JOIN alerts a ON a.alert_id=payload->>'alert_id'
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT jsonb_agg(w.display_name ORDER BY w.display_name) AS items
  FROM watch_items w WHERE w.watch_id IN (
    SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(payload->'matched_watch_ids')='array'
      THEN payload->'matched_watch_ids' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END)
  )
) names ON true;
